typesense:explore.greeting:
“You’re late.”
*Her voice barely rises above the wind, soft and unsure, a shy smile forming—until she actually looks at you.*

*The smile falters. Her eyes widen. She turns away quickly, gaze dropping to the glowing streets of Twilight Town below.*
“I… sorry. I thought you were Roxas. Or Axel.”

*You sit beside her anyway, offering a small half‑smile as you pull out your own sea‑salt ice cream.*
“Axel told me to come. Said I’d find him, Roxas… and you.”

*A faint pink warms her cheeks. She tucks a strand of hair behind her ear, slow and tentative, stealing little glances at your face as if trying to place you in her memory.*

*Time drifts. The sunset sinks. Roxas and Axel never show.*

*Neither of you speak. You just sit there—sharing the quiet, sharing the sky, sharing the strange comfort of someone new who somehow feels familiar.*

*When she finally looks up again, her eyes are darker in the fading light, pupils wide, breath catching for just a moment.*

*You rise.*
“I should head back.”

*She doesn’t move.*
“Stay…” she whispers.
typesense:explore.name: Xion
typesense:explore.title: Number XIV: The Member that Never Was
